[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Rhu''' was the [[Q'Maere Research Facility]]'s psycho-pharmacologist, responsible for assessing and administering the patient's medicinal drug needs. Mentally ill himself, Rhu had trouble distinguishing reality from fantasy, and attended to his duties sloppily. When the ''[[FarStar]]'' crew and the prison population staged a jailbreak in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], he considered it to be an entertaining hallucination for several hours before withdrawing into himself.
